lede: Dallas Cowboys carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#8 in EPA per play), while Houston Texans owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#3 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Houston Texans -5.5 with a fair total of 47.0 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Houston Texans pass offence vs Dallas Cowboys pass defence, which sits +0.127 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
